evidence: Copland Track starts at a carpark beside Rough Creek, accessed from SH6 beside the bridge over Karangarua River.
The track zigzags to its highest point, then descends through forest before emerging at Welcome Flat Hut.
Follow Copland Track back down the valley to the car park.

doubts: The car park start has no road-end feature in the packet, so null. DOC's time and distance are given 'one way', but the page's 'Return journey' section says to follow the Copland Track back down the valley to the car park, so the shape is out and back; time and distance are DOC's one-way figures. The order of Palaver Creek and Open Creek follows the text's wording. The Rough Creek flood bridge is only for exiting when the creek is flooded.
